measurements.anchor_compute_sec_note: training work / published throughput of the anchor: 2 epochs x 100 iterations x batch 720 = 144000 images; / 1396.0 images/s. The benchmark's throughput covers the training steps: start-up and validation are outside it
measurements.compute_ratio_note: throughput[anchor] / throughput[GPU]; rows of one GPU (different hosts) pooled by geometric mean
measurements.vram_gb_at_most_note: the run completed with batch 720 on 40 GB cards, so the peak is at most 40 GB; Lambda's batch sizes grow with card memory, so the peak is likely close to the card size; this bound does not check an underestimate
